name: Passport Reading Comfort 500
scope: 50 existing source-linked research passports × ten genuinely usable reading/navigation/print controls. Not 500 research records or 500 independently verified physical facilities.
preservation: Original 50 research objects, 72 source HTML pages and original palette remain unchanged.
implementation: One new dynamically injected collapsible reading toolbar, a shared script-loader reference, additive stylesheet rules.
privacy: No preference or personal data transmitted or stored; visual settings affect the current page only.
caveat: Focus mode temporarily hides only supplementary generated tooling; original project overview and facts remain. Print is browser-controlled.
